source_refs.locator: Section 4.4.1, printed p. 51 (PDF p. 67), rainfall population estimates.

evidence.scenario: Moderate- and high-emissions scenarios; the passage does not specify scenario labels.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.3, printed p. 39 (PDF p. 52), urban flood exposure.

evidence.compact_statement: The CCDR reports that over 60% of Liberia’s urban population lives in informal settlements and that wetland and floodplain development in Greater Monrovia leaves dwellings waterlogged and flooded during the rainy season.

affected_groups: Population living within 50 km of the coast
evidence.compact_statement: Liberia’s NDC describes its 580-km coastline as exposed to sea-level rise, erosion, and storm surges, especially near Monrovia and Buchanan; it reports that 60% of the population lives within 50 km of the coast.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Coastal Zones, printed pp. 31-32 (PDF pp. 31-32), 2035 adaptation targets.

affected_groups: Residents of vulnerable urban slums and informal settlements
evidence.scenario: Government adaptation targets for 2035, not outcome projections.
evidence.compact_statement: The NDC sets 2035 targets for green-grey infrastructure along 60% of the highly vulnerable coastline, coastal-flood early warning and scenario modeling, and flood-resilient water and sanitation in at least 40% of vulnerable urban slums and informal settlements.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
